plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate. Reduce CRWD to 10% and SMH to 5% to lower single name and sector concentration. Buy ALB at 10% to add a top-quality name and diversify the portfolio.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a realistic ~1.5%/month outlook. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits potential upside. Expect lower drawdowns and a more stable portfolio value.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate. Buy ALB at 4% to add a quality name and diversify. Add to CRWD to 16% to lean into a strong performer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting a realistic ~2.5%/month outlook. It maintains some leveraged exposure while reducing overall concentration. Expect moderate drawdowns and a blend of stability and growth potential.

plan: Add to SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to increase leveraged exposure. Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate. Buy ALB at 6% to add a high-scoring setup. Add to CRWD to 16% and SMH to 15% to increase exposure to strong sectors.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth with a realistic ~4%/month outlook. It significantly increases leverage and concentration, leading to higher potential returns but also much larger drawdowns. Be aware of leveraged ETF decay and the need for strict stop discipline to manage substantial risk.
